entry.name: OverlapThreshold
entry.label: Overlap needed to offer grouping (percent of the dragged window)

entry.name: DwellTimeMs
entry.label: Time a window must be held over a target (ms)

entry.name: HideInactive
entry.label: Inactive tabs: 1 = minimize them, 0 = only cover them

entry.name: RightInset
entry.label: Space reserved at the right end of the tab strip for the window buttons

entry.name: BarHeight
entry.label: Tab strip height when the window has no server side title bar

entry.name: DragOutDistance
entry.label: Distance a tab must be dragged out of the strip to detach it

entry.name: GroupDragOnStrip
entry.label: Move the whole group by dragging the empty part of the tab strip

entry.name: RestoreAfterRestart
entry.label: Rebuild groups after a restart (matches windows by application and title or position)

entry.name: RestoreWindowMinutes
entry.label: How long a saved group stays restorable (minutes)

entry.name: MatchTolerancePx
entry.label: Allowed position difference when matching restored windows (px)
